{"timestamp":"2025-11-28T10:34:26.605703Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"WITH reservations AS ( …","db.statement":"\n\n\n            WITH reservations AS (\n                SELECT flash_sale_id, SUM(quantity) AS reserved_quantity\n                FROM live_flash_sale_reservations\n                GROUP BY flash_sale_id\n            )\n            SELECT\n                lfs.id,\n                lfs.live_session_id,\n                lfs.service_id,\n                lfs.stock_target,\n                COALESCE(res.reserved_quantity, 0) AS reserved_quantity,\n                lfs.commentary_interval_seconds,\n                lfs.last_commentary_sent_at,\n                lfs.end_at,\n                COALESCE(lfs.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) AS flash_metadata,\n                ls.host_user_id,\n                ls.service_id AS primary_service_id,\n                COALESCE(ls.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) AS session_metadata,\n                ls.title\n            FROM live_flash_sales lfs\n            JOIN live_sessions ls ON ls.id = lfs.live_session_id\n            LEFT JOIN reservations res ON res.flash_sale_id = lfs.id\n            WHERE lfs.status = 'live'\n              AND lfs.commentary_mode = 'ai_voice'\n              AND lfs.end_at > $1\n              AND (\n                    lfs.last_commentary_sent_at IS NULL\n                    OR lfs.last_commentary_sent_at <= $1 - make_interval(secs => lfs.commentary_interval_seconds)\n              )\n            \n","rows_affected":0,"rows_returned":0,"elapsed":"1.250779ms","elapsed_secs":0.001250779},"target":"sqlx::query"}

{"timestamp":"2025-11-28T10:33:26.604182Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"WITH reservations AS ( …","db.statement":"\n\n\n            WITH reservations AS (\n                SELECT flash_sale_id, SUM(quantity) AS reserved_quantity\n                FROM live_flash_sale_reservations\n                GROUP BY flash_sale_id\n            )\n            SELECT\n                lfs.id,\n                lfs.live_session_id,\n                lfs.service_id,\n                lfs.stock_target,\n                COALESCE(res.reserved_quantity, 0) AS reserved_quantity,\n                lfs.commentary_interval_seconds,\n                lfs.last_commentary_sent_at,\n                lfs.end_at,\n                COALESCE(lfs.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) AS flash_metadata,\n                ls.host_user_id,\n                ls.service_id AS primary_service_id,\n                COALESCE(ls.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) AS session_metadata,\n                ls.title\n            FROM live_flash_sales lfs\n            JOIN live_sessions ls ON ls.id = lfs.live_session_id\n            LEFT JOIN reservations res ON res.flash_sale_id = lfs.id\n            WHERE lfs.status = 'live'\n              AND lfs.commentary_mode = 'ai_voice'\n              AND lfs.end_at > $1\n              AND (\n                    lfs.last_commentary_sent_at IS NULL\n                    OR lfs.last_commentary_sent_at <= $1 - make_interval(secs => lfs.commentary_interval_seconds)\n              )\n            \n","rows_affected":0,"rows_returned":0,"elapsed":"749.877µs","elapsed_secs":0.000749877},"target":"sqlx::query"}

{"timestamp":"2025-11-28T10:31:26.605636Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"WITH reservations AS ( …","db.statement":"\n\n\n            WITH reservations AS (\n                SELECT flash_sale_id, SUM(quantity) AS reserved_quantity\n                FROM live_flash_sale_reservations\n                GROUP BY flash_sale_id\n            )\n            SELECT\n                lfs.id,\n                lfs.live_session_id,\n                lfs.service_id,\n                lfs.stock_target,\n                COALESCE(res.reserved_quantity, 0) AS reserved_quantity,\n                lfs.commentary_interval_seconds,\n                lfs.last_commentary_sent_at,\n                lfs.end_at,\n                COALESCE(lfs.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) AS flash_metadata,\n                ls.host_user_id,\n                ls.service_id AS primary_service_id,\n                COALESCE(ls.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) AS session_metadata,\n                ls.title\n            FROM live_flash_sales lfs\n            JOIN live_sessions ls ON ls.id = lfs.live_session_id\n            LEFT JOIN reservations res ON res.flash_sale_id = lfs.id\n            WHERE lfs.status = 'live'\n              AND lfs.commentary_mode = 'ai_voice'\n              AND lfs.end_at > $1\n              AND (\n                    lfs.last_commentary_sent_at IS NULL\n                    OR lfs.last_commentary_sent_at <= $1 - make_interval(secs => lfs.commentary_interval_seconds)\n              )\n            \n","rows_affected":0,"rows_returned":0,"elapsed":"713.976µs","elapsed_secs":0.000713976},"target":"sqlx::query"}

{"timestamp":"2025-11-28T10:30:56.605886Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"WITH reservations AS ( …","db.statement":"\n\n\n            WITH reservations AS (\n                SELECT flash_sale_id, SUM(quantity) AS reserved_quantity\n                FROM live_flash_sale_reservations\n                GROUP BY flash_sale_id\n            )\n            SELECT\n                lfs.id,\n                lfs.live_session_id,\n                lfs.service_id,\n                lfs.stock_target,\n                COALESCE(res.reserved_quantity, 0) AS reserved_quantity,\n                lfs.commentary_interval_seconds,\n                lfs.last_commentary_sent_at,\n                lfs.end_at,\n                COALESCE(lfs.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) AS flash_metadata,\n                ls.host_user_id,\n                ls.service_id AS primary_service_id,\n                COALESCE(ls.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) AS session_metadata,\n                ls.title\n            FROM live_flash_sales lfs\n            JOIN live_sessions ls ON ls.id = lfs.live_session_id\n            LEFT JOIN reservations res ON res.flash_sale_id = lfs.id\n            WHERE lfs.status = 'live'\n              AND lfs.commentary_mode = 'ai_voice'\n              AND lfs.end_at > $1\n              AND (\n                    lfs.last_commentary_sent_at IS NULL\n                    OR lfs.last_commentary_sent_at <= $1 - make_interval(secs => lfs.commentary_interval_seconds)\n              )\n            \n","rows_affected":0,"rows_returned":0,"elapsed":"1.789212ms","elapsed_secs":0.001789212},"target":"sqlx::query"}

{"timestamp":"2025-11-28T10:30:26.605694Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"WITH reservations AS ( …","db.statement":"\n\n\n            WITH reservations AS (\n                SELECT flash_sale_id, SUM(quantity) AS reserved_quantity\n                FROM live_flash_sale_reservations\n                GROUP BY flash_sale_id\n            )\n            SELECT\n                lfs.id,\n                lfs.live_session_id,\n                lfs.service_id,\n                lfs.stock_target,\n                COALESCE(res.reserved_quantity, 0) AS reserved_quantity,\n                lfs.commentary_interval_seconds,\n                lfs.last_commentary_sent_at,\n                lfs.end_at,\n                COALESCE(lfs.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) AS flash_metadata,\n                ls.host_user_id,\n                ls.service_id AS primary_service_id,\n                COALESCE(ls.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) AS session_metadata,\n                ls.title\n            FROM live_flash_sales lfs\n            JOIN live_sessions ls ON ls.id = lfs.live_session_id\n            LEFT JOIN reservations res ON res.flash_sale_id = lfs.id\n            WHERE lfs.status = 'live'\n              AND lfs.commentary_mode = 'ai_voice'\n              AND lfs.end_at > $1\n              AND (\n                    lfs.last_commentary_sent_at IS NULL\n                    OR lfs.last_commentary_sent_at <= $1 - make_interval(secs => lfs.commentary_interval_seconds)\n              )\n            \n","rows_affected":0,"rows_returned":0,"elapsed":"1.083955ms","elapsed_secs":0.001083955},"target":"sqlx::query"}

{"timestamp":"2025-11-28T10:29:56.605378Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"WITH reservations AS ( …","db.statement":"\n\n\n            WITH reservations AS (\n                SELECT flash_sale_id, SUM(quantity) AS reserved_quantity\n                FROM live_flash_sale_reservations\n                GROUP BY flash_sale_id\n            )\n            SELECT\n                lfs.id,\n                lfs.live_session_id,\n                lfs.service_id,\n                lfs.stock_target,\n                COALESCE(res.reserved_quantity, 0) AS reserved_quantity,\n                lfs.commentary_interval_seconds,\n                lfs.last_commentary_sent_at,\n                lfs.end_at,\n                COALESCE(lfs.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) AS flash_metadata,\n                ls.host_user_id,\n                ls.service_id AS primary_service_id,\n                COALESCE(ls.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) AS session_metadata,\n                ls.title\n            FROM live_flash_sales lfs\n            JOIN live_sessions ls ON ls.id = lfs.live_session_id\n            LEFT JOIN reservations res ON res.flash_sale_id = lfs.id\n            WHERE lfs.status = 'live'\n              AND lfs.commentary_mode = 'ai_voice'\n              AND lfs.end_at > $1\n              AND (\n                    lfs.last_commentary_sent_at IS NULL\n                    OR lfs.last_commentary_sent_at <= $1 - make_interval(secs => lfs.commentary_interval_seconds)\n              )\n            \n","rows_affected":0,"rows_returned":0,"elapsed":"771.488µs","elapsed_secs":0.000771488},"target":"sqlx::query"}

{"timestamp":"2025-11-28T10:28:26.605126Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"WITH reservations AS ( …","db.statement":"\n\n\n            WITH reservations AS (\n                SELECT flash_sale_id, SUM(quantity) AS reserved_quantity\n                FROM live_flash_sale_reservations\n                GROUP BY flash_sale_id\n            )\n            SELECT\n                lfs.id,\n                lfs.live_session_id,\n                lfs.service_id,\n                lfs.stock_target,\n                COALESCE(res.reserved_quantity, 0) AS reserved_quantity,\n                lfs.commentary_interval_seconds,\n                lfs.last_commentary_sent_at,\n                lfs.end_at,\n                COALESCE(lfs.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) AS flash_metadata,\n                ls.host_user_id,\n                ls.service_id AS primary_service_id,\n                COALESCE(ls.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) AS session_metadata,\n                ls.title\n            FROM live_flash_sales lfs\n            JOIN live_sessions ls ON ls.id = lfs.live_session_id\n            LEFT JOIN reservations res ON res.flash_sale_id = lfs.id\n            WHERE lfs.status = 'live'\n              AND lfs.commentary_mode = 'ai_voice'\n              AND lfs.end_at > $1\n              AND (\n                    lfs.last_commentary_sent_at IS NULL\n                    OR lfs.last_commentary_sent_at <= $1 - make_interval(secs => lfs.commentary_interval_seconds)\n              )\n            \n","rows_affected":0,"rows_returned":0,"elapsed":"860.51µs","elapsed_secs":0.00086051},"target":"sqlx::query"}

{"timestamp":"2025-11-28T10:27:56.606629Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"UPDATE live_flash_sales SET status …","db.statement":"\n\nUPDATE live_flash_sales SET status = 'ended', updated_at = NOW() WHERE status IN ('scheduled', 'live') AND end_at <= $1\n","rows_affected":0,"rows_returned":0,"elapsed":"698.845µs","elapsed_secs":0.000698845},"target":"sqlx::query"}
{"timestamp":"2025-11-28T10:27:56.605245Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"WITH reservations AS ( …","db.statement":"\n\n\n            WITH reservations AS (\n                SELECT flash_sale_id, SUM(quantity) AS reserved_quantity\n                FROM live_flash_sale_reservations\n                GROUP BY flash_sale_id\n            )\n            SELECT\n                lfs.id,\n                lfs.live_session_id,\n                lfs.service_id,\n                lfs.stock_target,\n                COALESCE(res.reserved_quantity, 0) AS reserved_quantity,\n                lfs.commentary_interval_seconds,\n                lfs.last_commentary_sent_at,\n                lfs.end_at,\n                COALESCE(lfs.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) AS flash_metadata,\n                ls.host_user_id,\n                ls.service_id AS primary_service_id,\n                COALESCE(ls.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) AS session_metadata,\n                ls.title\n            FROM live_flash_sales lfs\n            JOIN live_sessions ls ON ls.id = lfs.live_session_id\n            LEFT JOIN reservations res ON res.flash_sale_id = lfs.id\n            WHERE lfs.status = 'live'\n              AND lfs.commentary_mode = 'ai_voice'\n              AND lfs.end_at > $1\n              AND (\n                    lfs.last_commentary_sent_at IS NULL\n                    OR lfs.last_commentary_sent_at <= $1 - make_interval(secs => lfs.commentary_interval_seconds)\n              )\n            \n","rows_affected":0,"rows_returned":0,"elapsed":"812.509µs","elapsed_secs":0.000812509},"target":"sqlx::query"}

{"timestamp":"2025-11-28T10:27:26.605710Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"WITH reservations AS ( …","db.statement":"\n\n\n            WITH reservations AS (\n                SELECT flash_sale_id, SUM(quantity) AS reserved_quantity\n                FROM live_flash_sale_reservations\n                GROUP BY flash_sale_id\n            )\n            SELECT\n                lfs.id,\n                lfs.live_session_id,\n                lfs.service_id,\n                lfs.stock_target,\n                COALESCE(res.reserved_quantity, 0) AS reserved_quantity,\n                lfs.commentary_interval_seconds,\n                lfs.last_commentary_sent_at,\n                lfs.end_at,\n                COALESCE(lfs.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) AS flash_metadata,\n                ls.host_user_id,\n                ls.service_id AS primary_service_id,\n                COALESCE(ls.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) AS session_metadata,\n                ls.title\n            FROM live_flash_sales lfs\n            JOIN live_sessions ls ON ls.id = lfs.live_session_id\n            LEFT JOIN reservations res ON res.flash_sale_id = lfs.id\n            WHERE lfs.status = 'live'\n              AND lfs.commentary_mode = 'ai_voice'\n              AND lfs.end_at > $1\n              AND (\n                    lfs.last_commentary_sent_at IS NULL\n                    OR lfs.last_commentary_sent_at <= $1 - make_interval(secs => lfs.commentary_interval_seconds)\n              )\n            \n","rows_affected":0,"rows_returned":0,"elapsed":"1.089976ms","elapsed_secs":0.001089976},"target":"sqlx::query"}

{"timestamp":"2025-11-28T10:26:26.605673Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"WITH reservations AS ( …","db.statement":"\n\n\n            WITH reservations AS (\n                SELECT flash_sale_id, SUM(quantity) AS reserved_quantity\n                FROM live_flash_sale_reservations\n                GROUP BY flash_sale_id\n            )\n            SELECT\n                lfs.id,\n                lfs.live_session_id,\n                lfs.service_id,\n                lfs.stock_target,\n                COALESCE(res.reserved_quantity, 0) AS reserved_quantity,\n                lfs.commentary_interval_seconds,\n                lfs.last_commentary_sent_at,\n                lfs.end_at,\n                COALESCE(lfs.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) AS flash_metadata,\n                ls.host_user_id,\n                ls.service_id AS primary_service_id,\n                COALESCE(ls.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) AS session_metadata,\n                ls.title\n            FROM live_flash_sales lfs\n            JOIN live_sessions ls ON ls.id = lfs.live_session_id\n            LEFT JOIN reservations res ON res.flash_sale_id = lfs.id\n            WHERE lfs.status = 'live'\n              AND lfs.commentary_mode = 'ai_voice'\n              AND lfs.end_at > $1\n              AND (\n                    lfs.last_commentary_sent_at IS NULL\n                    OR lfs.last_commentary_sent_at <= $1 - make_interval(secs => lfs.commentary_interval_seconds)\n              )\n            \n","rows_affected":0,"rows_returned":0,"elapsed":"1.169818ms","elapsed_secs":0.001169818},"target":"sqlx::query"}

{"timestamp":"2025-11-28T10:25:26.607132Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"WITH reservations AS ( …","db.statement":"\n\n\n            WITH reservations AS (\n                SELECT flash_sale_id, SUM(quantity) AS reserved_quantity\n                FROM live_flash_sale_reservations\n                GROUP BY flash_sale_id\n            )\n            SELECT\n                lfs.id,\n                lfs.live_session_id,\n                lfs.service_id,\n                lfs.stock_target,\n                COALESCE(res.reserved_quantity, 0) AS reserved_quantity,\n                lfs.commentary_interval_seconds,\n                lfs.last_commentary_sent_at,\n                lfs.end_at,\n                COALESCE(lfs.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) AS flash_metadata,\n                ls.host_user_id,\n                ls.service_id AS primary_service_id,\n                COALESCE(ls.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) AS session_metadata,\n                ls.title\n            FROM live_flash_sales lfs\n            JOIN live_sessions ls ON ls.id = lfs.live_session_id\n            LEFT JOIN reservations res ON res.flash_sale_id = lfs.id\n            WHERE lfs.status = 'live'\n              AND lfs.commentary_mode = 'ai_voice'\n              AND lfs.end_at > $1\n              AND (\n                    lfs.last_commentary_sent_at IS NULL\n                    OR lfs.last_commentary_sent_at <= $1 - make_interval(secs => lfs.commentary_interval_seconds)\n              )\n            \n","rows_affected":0,"rows_returned":0,"elapsed":"1.359091ms","elapsed_secs":0.001359091},"target":"sqlx::query"}

{"timestamp":"2025-11-28T10:24:56.606419Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"UPDATE live_flash_sales SET status …","db.statement":"\n\nUPDATE live_flash_sales SET status = 'ended', updated_at = NOW() WHERE status IN ('scheduled', 'live') AND end_at <= $1\n","rows_affected":0,"rows_returned":0,"elapsed":"751.068µs","elapsed_secs":0.000751068},"target":"sqlx::query"}
{"timestamp":"2025-11-28T10:24:56.605048Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"WITH reservations AS ( …","db.statement":"\n\n\n            WITH reservations AS (\n                SELECT flash_sale_id, SUM(quantity) AS reserved_quantity\n                FROM live_flash_sale_reservations\n                GROUP BY flash_sale_id\n            )\n            SELECT\n                lfs.id,\n                lfs.live_session_id,\n                lfs.service_id,\n                lfs.stock_target,\n                COALESCE(res.reserved_quantity, 0) AS reserved_quantity,\n                lfs.commentary_interval_seconds,\n                lfs.last_commentary_sent_at,\n                lfs.end_at,\n                COALESCE(lfs.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) AS flash_metadata,\n                ls.host_user_id,\n                ls.service_id AS primary_service_id,\n                COALESCE(ls.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) AS session_metadata,\n                ls.title\n            FROM live_flash_sales lfs\n            JOIN live_sessions ls ON ls.id = lfs.live_session_id\n            LEFT JOIN reservations res ON res.flash_sale_id = lfs.id\n            WHERE lfs.status = 'live'\n              AND lfs.commentary_mode = 'ai_voice'\n              AND lfs.end_at > $1\n              AND (\n                    lfs.last_commentary_sent_at IS NULL\n                    OR lfs.last_commentary_sent_at <= $1 - make_interval(secs => lfs.commentary_interval_seconds)\n              )\n            \n","rows_affected":0,"rows_returned":0,"elapsed":"1.191227ms","elapsed_secs":0.001191227},"target":"sqlx::query"}

{"timestamp":"2025-11-28T10:23:56.605876Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"WITH reservations AS ( …","db.statement":"\n\n\n            WITH reservations AS (\n                SELECT flash_sale_id, SUM(quantity) AS reserved_quantity\n                FROM live_flash_sale_reservations\n                GROUP BY flash_sale_id\n            )\n            SELECT\n                lfs.id,\n                lfs.live_session_id,\n                lfs.service_id,\n                lfs.stock_target,\n                COALESCE(res.reserved_quantity, 0) AS reserved_quantity,\n                lfs.commentary_interval_seconds,\n                lfs.last_commentary_sent_at,\n                lfs.end_at,\n                COALESCE(lfs.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) AS flash_metadata,\n                ls.host_user_id,\n                ls.service_id AS primary_service_id,\n                COALESCE(ls.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) AS session_metadata,\n                ls.title\n            FROM live_flash_sales lfs\n            JOIN live_sessions ls ON ls.id = lfs.live_session_id\n            LEFT JOIN reservations res ON res.flash_sale_id = lfs.id\n            WHERE lfs.status = 'live'\n              AND lfs.commentary_mode = 'ai_voice'\n              AND lfs.end_at > $1\n              AND (\n                    lfs.last_commentary_sent_at IS NULL\n                    OR lfs.last_commentary_sent_at <= $1 - make_interval(secs => lfs.commentary_interval_seconds)\n              )\n            \n","rows_affected":0,"rows_returned":0,"elapsed":"1.087545ms","elapsed_secs":0.001087545},"target":"sqlx::query"}

{"timestamp":"2025-11-28T10:23:26.606514Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"WITH reservations AS ( …","db.statement":"\n\n\n            WITH reservations AS (\n                SELECT flash_sale_id, SUM(quantity) AS reserved_quantity\n                FROM live_flash_sale_reservations\n                GROUP BY flash_sale_id\n            )\n            SELECT\n                lfs.id,\n                lfs.live_session_id,\n                lfs.service_id,\n                lfs.stock_target,\n                COALESCE(res.reserved_quantity, 0) AS reserved_quantity,\n                lfs.commentary_interval_seconds,\n                lfs.last_commentary_sent_at,\n                lfs.end_at,\n                COALESCE(lfs.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) AS flash_metadata,\n                ls.host_user_id,\n                ls.service_id AS primary_service_id,\n                COALESCE(ls.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) AS session_metadata,\n                ls.title\n            FROM live_flash_sales lfs\n            JOIN live_sessions ls ON ls.id = lfs.live_session_id\n            LEFT JOIN reservations res ON res.flash_sale_id = lfs.id\n            WHERE lfs.status = 'live'\n              AND lfs.commentary_mode = 'ai_voice'\n              AND lfs.end_at > $1\n              AND (\n                    lfs.last_commentary_sent_at IS NULL\n                    OR lfs.last_commentary_sent_at <= $1 - make_interval(secs => lfs.commentary_interval_seconds)\n              )\n            \n","rows_affected":0,"rows_returned":0,"elapsed":"1.122315ms","elapsed_secs":0.001122315},"target":"sqlx::query"}

{"timestamp":"2025-11-28T10:21:26.606026Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"WITH reservations AS ( …","db.statement":"\n\n\n            WITH reservations AS (\n                SELECT flash_sale_id, SUM(quantity) AS reserved_quantity\n                FROM live_flash_sale_reservations\n                GROUP BY flash_sale_id\n            )\n            SELECT\n                lfs.id,\n                lfs.live_session_id,\n                lfs.service_id,\n                lfs.stock_target,\n                COALESCE(res.reserved_quantity, 0) AS reserved_quantity,\n                lfs.commentary_interval_seconds,\n                lfs.last_commentary_sent_at,\n                lfs.end_at,\n                COALESCE(lfs.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) AS flash_metadata,\n                ls.host_user_id,\n                ls.service_id AS primary_service_id,\n                COALESCE(ls.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) AS session_metadata,\n                ls.title\n            FROM live_flash_sales lfs\n            JOIN live_sessions ls ON ls.id = lfs.live_session_id\n            LEFT JOIN reservations res ON res.flash_sale_id = lfs.id\n            WHERE lfs.status = 'live'\n              AND lfs.commentary_mode = 'ai_voice'\n              AND lfs.end_at > $1\n              AND (\n                    lfs.last_commentary_sent_at IS NULL\n                    OR lfs.last_commentary_sent_at <= $1 - make_interval(secs => lfs.commentary_interval_seconds)\n              )\n            \n","rows_affected":0,"rows_returned":0,"elapsed":"1.134846ms","elapsed_secs":0.001134846},"target":"sqlx::query"}

{"timestamp":"2025-11-28T10:20:56.605768Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"WITH reservations AS ( …","db.statement":"\n\n\n            WITH reservations AS (\n                SELECT flash_sale_id, SUM(quantity) AS reserved_quantity\n                FROM live_flash_sale_reservations\n                GROUP BY flash_sale_id\n            )\n            SELECT\n                lfs.id,\n                lfs.live_session_id,\n                lfs.service_id,\n                lfs.stock_target,\n                COALESCE(res.reserved_quantity, 0) AS reserved_quantity,\n                lfs.commentary_interval_seconds,\n                lfs.last_commentary_sent_at,\n                lfs.end_at,\n                COALESCE(lfs.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) AS flash_metadata,\n                ls.host_user_id,\n                ls.service_id AS primary_service_id,\n                COALESCE(ls.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) AS session_metadata,\n                ls.title\n            FROM live_flash_sales lfs\n            JOIN live_sessions ls ON ls.id = lfs.live_session_id\n            LEFT JOIN reservations res ON res.flash_sale_id = lfs.id\n            WHERE lfs.status = 'live'\n              AND lfs.commentary_mode = 'ai_voice'\n              AND lfs.end_at > $1\n              AND (\n                    lfs.last_commentary_sent_at IS NULL\n                    OR lfs.last_commentary_sent_at <= $1 - make_interval(secs => lfs.commentary_interval_seconds)\n              )\n            \n","rows_affected":0,"rows_returned":0,"elapsed":"1.064075ms","elapsed_secs":0.001064075},"target":"sqlx::query"}

{"timestamp":"2025-11-28T10:20:26.607024Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"WITH reservations AS ( …","db.statement":"\n\n\n            WITH reservations AS (\n                SELECT flash_sale_id, SUM(quantity) AS reserved_quantity\n                FROM live_flash_sale_reservations\n                GROUP BY flash_sale_id\n            )\n            SELECT\n                lfs.id,\n                lfs.live_session_id,\n                lfs.service_id,\n                lfs.stock_target,\n                COALESCE(res.reserved_quantity, 0) AS reserved_quantity,\n                lfs.commentary_interval_seconds,\n                lfs.last_commentary_sent_at,\n                lfs.end_at,\n                COALESCE(lfs.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) AS flash_metadata,\n                ls.host_user_id,\n                ls.service_id AS primary_service_id,\n                COALESCE(ls.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) AS session_metadata,\n                ls.title\n            FROM live_flash_sales lfs\n            JOIN live_sessions ls ON ls.id = lfs.live_session_id\n            LEFT JOIN reservations res ON res.flash_sale_id = lfs.id\n            WHERE lfs.status = 'live'\n              AND lfs.commentary_mode = 'ai_voice'\n              AND lfs.end_at > $1\n              AND (\n                    lfs.last_commentary_sent_at IS NULL\n                    OR lfs.last_commentary_sent_at <= $1 - make_interval(secs => lfs.commentary_interval_seconds)\n              )\n            \n","rows_affected":0,"rows_returned":0,"elapsed":"1.229709ms","elapsed_secs":0.001229709},"target":"sqlx::query"}

{"timestamp":"2025-11-28T10:18:26.606512Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"WITH reservations AS ( …","db.statement":"\n\n\n            WITH reservations AS (\n                SELECT flash_sale_id, SUM(quantity) AS reserved_quantity\n                FROM live_flash_sale_reservations\n                GROUP BY flash_sale_id\n            )\n            SELECT\n                lfs.id,\n                lfs.live_session_id,\n                lfs.service_id,\n                lfs.stock_target,\n                COALESCE(res.reserved_quantity, 0) AS reserved_quantity,\n                lfs.commentary_interval_seconds,\n                lfs.last_commentary_sent_at,\n                lfs.end_at,\n                COALESCE(lfs.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) AS flash_metadata,\n                ls.host_user_id,\n                ls.service_id AS primary_service_id,\n                COALESCE(ls.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) AS session_metadata,\n                ls.title\n            FROM live_flash_sales lfs\n            JOIN live_sessions ls ON ls.id = lfs.live_session_id\n            LEFT JOIN reservations res ON res.flash_sale_id = lfs.id\n            WHERE lfs.status = 'live'\n              AND lfs.commentary_mode = 'ai_voice'\n              AND lfs.end_at > $1\n              AND (\n                    lfs.last_commentary_sent_at IS NULL\n                    OR lfs.last_commentary_sent_at <= $1 - make_interval(secs => lfs.commentary_interval_seconds)\n              )\n            \n","rows_affected":0,"rows_returned":0,"elapsed":"1.163187ms","elapsed_secs":0.001163187},"target":"sqlx::query"}

{"timestamp":"2025-11-28T10:16:56.608320Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"UPDATE live_flash_sales SET status …","db.statement":"\n\nUPDATE live_flash_sales SET status = 'ended', updated_at = NOW() WHERE status IN ('scheduled', 'live') AND end_at <= $1\n","rows_affected":0,"rows_returned":0,"elapsed":"1.629997ms","elapsed_secs":0.001629997},"target":"sqlx::query"}
{"timestamp":"2025-11-28T10:16:56.605952Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"WITH reservations AS ( …","db.statement":"\n\n\n            WITH reservations AS (\n                SELECT flash_sale_id, SUM(quantity) AS reserved_quantity\n                FROM live_flash_sale_reservations\n                GROUP BY flash_sale_id\n            )\n            SELECT\n                lfs.id,\n                lfs.live_session_id,\n                lfs.service_id,\n                lfs.stock_target,\n                COALESCE(res.reserved_quantity, 0) AS reserved_quantity,\n                lfs.commentary_interval_seconds,\n                lfs.last_commentary_sent_at,\n                lfs.end_at,\n                COALESCE(lfs.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) AS flash_metadata,\n                ls.host_user_id,\n                ls.service_id AS primary_service_id,\n                COALESCE(ls.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) AS session_metadata,\n                ls.title\n            FROM live_flash_sales lfs\n            JOIN live_sessions ls ON ls.id = lfs.live_session_id\n            LEFT JOIN reservations res ON res.flash_sale_id = lfs.id\n            WHERE lfs.status = 'live'\n              AND lfs.commentary_mode = 'ai_voice'\n              AND lfs.end_at > $1\n              AND (\n                    lfs.last_commentary_sent_at IS NULL\n                    OR lfs.last_commentary_sent_at <= $1 - make_interval(secs => lfs.commentary_interval_seconds)\n              )\n            \n","rows_affected":0,"rows_returned":0,"elapsed":"1.309021ms","elapsed_secs":0.001309021},"target":"sqlx::query"}

                           'Service sans titre'\n                        ) as titre_service,\n                        -- Extraire description (tronquée à 200 caractères pour la liste)\n                        LEFT(\n                            COALESCE(\n                                s.data->>'description',\n                                s.data->'description'->>'valeur',\n -- Page de management = prestataire doit voir tous ses produits pour les gérer\n                        COALESCE(\n                            (\n                                SELECT jsonb_agg(\n                                    jsonb_build_object(\n                                        'nom', COALESCE(p.product->>'nom', p.product->>'name', p.product->>'titre', ''),\n -- ✅ Inclure is_active pour indicateur visuel\n                                    )\n                                    ORDER BY p.idx\n                                )\n                                FROM LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(\n                                    CASE \n                                        WHEN jsonb_typeof(s.data->'produits') = 'array' THEN s.data->'produits'\n                      END\n                                ) WITH ORDINALITY AS p(product, idx)\n                                LEFT JOIN products_lifecycle pl \n                                    ON pl.service_id = s.id AND pl.product_index = p.idx - 1\n                                -- ✅ Pas de filtre WHERE : afficher TOUS les produits pour management\n                            ),\n management\n                        -- Le prestataire doit voir le nombre total de produits qu'il a créés\n                        COALESCE(\n                            jsonb_array_length(\n                                CASE \n                                    WHEN jsonb_typeof(s.data->'produits') = 'array' THEN s.data->'produits'\n                                    WHEN jsonb_typeof(s.data->'produits'->'valeur') = 'array' THEN s.data->'produits'->'valeur'\n                                    ELSE '[]'::jsonb\n                                END\n                            )::BIGINT,\n                            0\n                        ) as produits_count,\n                        -- Garder seulement le place_id de Google Places\n                        s.data->'google_place'->>'place_id' as google_place_id\n                    FROM services s\n                    WHERE s.user_id = $1\n                    ORDER BY s.created_at DESC\n {"timestamp":"2025-11-28T10:16:17.251458Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"SELECT s.id, s.is_active, s.created_at, …","db.statement":"\n\n\n                    SELECT \n                        s.id,\n                        s.is_active,\n                        s.created_at,\n                        s.category,\n                        -- Extraire titre_service (support des deux formats)\n                        COALESCE(\n                            s.data->>'titre_service',\n                            s.data->'titre_service'->>'valeur',\n                            s.data->>'titre',\n                            'Service sans titre'\n                        ) as titre_service,\n                        -- Extraire description (tronquée à 200 caractères pour la liste)\n                        LEFT(\n                            COALESCE(\n                                s.data->>'description',\n                                s.data->'description'->>'valeur',\n                                ''\n                            ),\n                            200\n                        ) as description_preview,\n                        -- ✅ CORRIGÉ 2025-11-28: Afficher TOUS les produits (actifs ET désactivés) pour la page de management\n                        -- Le champ is_active est inclus pour que le frontend puisse afficher un indicateur visuel\n                        -- Page de management = prestataire doit voir tous ses produits pour les gérer\n                        COALESCE(\n                            (\n                                SELECT jsonb_agg(\n                                    jsonb_build_object(\n                                        'nom', COALESCE(p.product->>'nom', p.product->>'name', p.product->>'titre', ''),\n                                        'prix', p.product->>'prix',\n                                        'devise', p.product->>'devise',\n                                        'is_active', COALESCE(pl.is_active, true)  -- ✅ Inclure is_active pour indicateur visuel\n                                    )\n                                    ORDER BY p.idx\n                                )\n                                FROM LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(\n                                    CASE \n                                        WHEN jsonb_typeof(s.data->'produits') = 'array' THEN s.data->'produits'\n                                        WHEN jsonb_typeof(s.data->'produits'->'valeur') = 'array' THEN s.data->'produits'->'valeur'\n                                        ELSE '[]'::jsonb\n                                    END\n                                ) WITH ORDINALITY AS p(product, idx)\n                                LEFT JOIN products_lifecycle pl \n                                    ON pl.service_id = s.id AND pl.product_index = p.idx - 1\n                                -- ✅ Pas de filtre WHERE : afficher TOUS les produits pour management\n                            ),\n                            '[]'::jsonb\n                        ) as produits_light,\n                        -- ✅ CORRIGÉ 2025-11-28: Compter TOUS les produits (actifs ET désactivés) pour la page de management\n                        -- Le prestataire doit voir le nombre total de produits qu'il a créés\n                        COALESCE(\n                            jsonb_array_length(\n                                CASE \n                                    WHEN jsonb_typeof(s.data->'produits') = 'array' THEN s.data->'produits'\n                                    WHEN jsonb_typeof(s.data->'produits'->'valeur') = 'array' THEN s.data->'produits'->'valeur'\n                                    ELSE '[]'::jsonb\n                                END\n                            )::BIGINT,\n                            0\n                        ) as produits_count,\n                        -- Garder seulement le place_id de Google Places\n                        s.data->'google_place'->>'place_id' as google_place_id\n                    FROM services s\n                    WHERE s.user_id = $1\n                    ORDER BY s.created_at DESC\n                    LIMIT $2 OFFSET $3\n                    \n","rows_affected":1,"rows_returned":1,"elapsed":"1.374231ms","elapsed_secs":0.001374231},"target":"sqlx::query"}

                           'Service sans titre'\n                        ) as titre_service,\n                        -- Extraire description (tronquée à 200 caractères pour la liste)\n                        LEFT(\n                            COALESCE(\n                                s.data->>'description',\n                                s.data->'description'->>'valeur',\n -- Page de management = prestataire doit voir tous ses produits pour les gérer\n                        COALESCE(\n                            (\n                                SELECT jsonb_agg(\n                                    jsonb_build_object(\n                                        'nom', COALESCE(p.product->>'nom', p.product->>'name', p.product->>'titre', ''),\n                                        'prix', p.product->>'prix',\n                                        'devise', p.product->>'devise',\n                                        'is_active', COALESCE(pl.is_active, true)  -- ✅ Inclure is_active pour indicateur visuel\n                                    )\n                                    ORDER BY p.idx\n                                )\n                                FROM LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(\n                                    CASE \n                                        WHEN jsonb_typeof(s.data->'produits') = 'array' THEN s.data->'produits'\n                                        WHEN jsonb_typeof(s.data->'produits'->'valeur') = 'array' THEN s.data->'produits'->'valeur'\n                                        ELSE '[]'::jsonb\n                                    END\n                                ) WITH ORDINALITY AS p(product, idx)\n                                LEFT JOIN products_lifecycle pl \n                                    ON pl.service_id = s.id AND pl.product_index = p.idx - 1\n                                -- ✅ Pas de filtre WHERE : afficher TOUS les produits pour management\n                            ),\n management\n                        -- Le prestataire doit voir le nombre total de produits qu'il a créés\n                        COALESCE(\n                            jsonb_array_length(\n                                CASE \n                                    WHEN jsonb_typeof(s.data->'produits') = 'array' THEN s.data->'produits'\n                                    WHEN jsonb_typeof(s.data->'produits'->'valeur') = 'array' THEN s.data->'produits'->'valeur'\n                                    ELSE '[]'::jsonb\n                                END\n                            )::BIGINT,\n                            0\n                        ) as produits_count,\n                        -- Garder seulement le place_id de Google Places\n                        s.data->'google_place'->>'place_id' as google_place_id\n                    FROM services s\n                    WHERE s.user_id = $1\n                    ORDER BY s.created_at DESC\n jsonb_typeof(s.data->'produits'->'valeur') = 'array' THEN s.data->'produits'->'valeur'\n                                    ELSE '[]'::jsonb\n                                END\n                            )::BIGINT,\n                            0\n                        ) as produits_count,\n                        -- Garder seulement le place_id de Google Places\n                        s.data->'google_place'->>'place_id' as google_place_id\n                    FROM services s\n                    WHERE s.user_id = $1\n                    ORDER BY s.created_at DESC\n                       COALESCE(\n                            s.data->>'titre_service',\n                            s.data->'titre_service'->>'valeur',\n                            s.data->>'titre',\n                            'Service sans titre'\n                        ) as titre_service,\n                        -- Extraire description (tronquée à 200 caractères pour la liste)\n                        LEFT(\n                            COALESCE(\n                                s.data->>'description',\n                                s.data->'description'->>'valeur',\n                                ''\n                            ),\n                            200\n                        ) as description_preview,\n                        -- ✅ CORRIGÉ 2025-11-28: Afficher TOUS les produits (actifs ET désactivés) pour la page de management\n                        -- Le champ is_active est inclus pour que le frontend puisse afficher un indicateur visuel\n                        -- Page de management = prestataire doit voir tous ses produits pour les gérer\n                        COALESCE(\n                            (\n                                SELECT jsonb_agg(\n                                    jsonb_build_object(\n                                        'nom', COALESCE(p.product->>'nom', p.product->>'name', p.product->>'titre', ''),\n                                        'prix', p.product->>'prix',\n                                        'devise', p.product->>'devise',\n                                        'is_active', COALESCE(pl.is_active, true)  -- ✅ Inclure is_active pour indicateur visuel\n                                    )\n                                    ORDER BY p.idx\n                                )\n                                FROM LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(\n                                    CASE \n                                        WHEN jsonb_typeof(s.data->'produits') = 'array' THEN s.data->'produits'\n                                        WHEN jsonb_typeof(s.data->'produits'->'valeur') = 'array' THEN s.data->'produits'->'valeur'\n                                        ELSE '[]'::jsonb\n                                    END\n                                ) WITH ORDINALITY AS p(product, idx)\n                                LEFT JOIN products_lifecycle pl \n                                    ON pl.service_id = s.id AND pl.product_index = p.idx - 1\n                                -- ✅ Pas de filtre WHERE : afficher TOUS les produits pour management\n                            ),\n                            '[]'::jsonb\n                        ) as produits_light,\n                        -- ✅ CORRIGÉ 2025-11-28: Compter TOUS les produits (actifs ET désactivés) pour la page de management\n                        -- Le prestataire doit voir le nombre total de produits qu'il a créés\n                        COALESCE(\n                            jsonb_array_length(\n                                CASE \n                                    WHEN jsonb_typeof(s.data->'produits') = 'array' THEN s.data->'produits'\n                                    WHEN jsonb_typeof(s.data->'produits'->'valeur') = 'array' THEN s.data->'produits'->'valeur'\n                                    ELSE '[]'::jsonb\n                                END\n                            )::BIGINT,\n                            0\n                        ) as produits_count,\n                        -- Garder seulement le place_id de Google Places\n                        s.data->'google_place'->>'place_id' as google_place_id\n                    FROM services s\n                    WHERE s.user_id = $1\n                    ORDER BY s.created_at DESC\n
